dct_description_sm:
Provides poll-by-poll results as well as the number of registered voters and votes cast by voting place.

Accuracy: There are no known errors in these data sets.

Update Frequency:n/a

Attributes:
  • Number of registered voters and votes cast by voting place and office
  • Number of votes cast for candidate by voting place 

Contact: Elections & MFIPPA Branch


Download note: If you are having problems downloading using Microsoft Edge as your web browser, try disabling the “Open Office files in the browser” option in Settings.
